g.text: Each follows nothing, and no Project's
An arrow means must be Ready first. Each Project's unit is apps-<project>, derived from the dependency graph, never declared;
it follows a Platform Project's unit for each platform role it needs: the proxy its tiers name, the Secret Store its grants read.
